caseStudies.summary: Exploring the chemicals industry's structural downturn, driven by global oversupply, trade and regulatory pressure, and shifting supply chains, and walks through the value chain from feedstocks to distribution. We end by naming long-term investment opportunities in U.S. specialty chemicals and the end markets they serve: semiconductors, pharmaceuticals and agriculture.
